summary: Mitek Systems filed an 8-K reporting Q3 FY2026 financial results (revenue $54.0M, up 18% YoY) and raised FY2026 guidance. Separately, on August 5, 2026, the board elected Mark Rossi as non-executive Chairman effective October 1, 2026, succeeding Scott Carter, who steps down due to personal time constraints but remains a director. The chairman transition is a routine succession with no disagreement or abrupt departure. The filing contains no special-situation transaction such as M&A, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event. Items 2.02 and 8.01 are standard operational updates, not special situations.
